name: UK Local Business Lead Finder (Google Sheets & Supabase Sync)

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "name": "Owner / Director",
  "business_name": "{{ $json['Business Name'] }}",
  "phone": "{{ $json['Phone'] }}",
  "website": {{ $json['Website'] === 'None' ? 'null' : '"' + $json['Website'] + '"' }},
  "service_interested": "Digital Storefront & Speed-to-Lead Automation",
  "notes": "{{ $json['Address'] }} · Rating: ★{{ $json['Rating'] }} ({{ $json['Reviews'] }} reviews)",
  "status": "New",
  "source": "google_maps_outreach",
  "lead_type": "local",
  "local_business_niche": "{{ $json['Trade'] }}",
  "outreach_category": "{{ $json['Classification'] }}",
  "outreach_stage": "uncontacted",
  "whatsapp_direct_url": {{ $json['WhatsApp Link'] === 'N/A' ? 'null' : '"' + $json['WhatsApp Link'] + '"' }},
  "scraped_metadata": {
    "address": "{{ $json['Address'] }}",
    "rating": {{ $json['Rating'] }},
    "reviews": {{ $json['Reviews'] }},
    "reviews_count": {{ $json['Reviews'] }},
    "rating_reviews": "{{ $json['Reviews'] }} (★{{ $json['Rating'] }})",
    "trade": "{{ $json['Trade'] }}",
    "stage_1_opener": "{{ $json['Stage 1 Opener'] }}",
    "stage_2_pitch": "{{ $json['Stage 2 Pitch'].replace(/\n/g, ' ') }}",
    "follow_up_declined": "{{ $json['Follow Up Declined'] }}"
  }
}
